name: Resilience4j Retry Configuration
description: JSON structure for Resilience4j Retry configuration.

fields.name: maxAttempts
fields.description: Maximum number of attempts (including initial call).

fields.name: retryExceptions
fields.description: Exception classes that trigger a retry.

fields.name: ignoreExceptions
fields.description: Exception classes that are not retried.

fields.name: retryOnResultPredicate
fields.description: Class name of a Predicate<T> that determines if a result triggers a retry.

fields.name: baseConfig
fields.description: Shared configuration name to inherit from (instances only).
